events.what: Punjab Legislative Assembly (117 seats): the Election Commission lists the current term as 17 March 2022 to 16 March 2027. A general election is due before the term ends; the schedule has not been announced.
events.effect: Election period: the Model Code of Conduct, heavy campaigning and some liquor-sale dry days around polling.

layers.authority: Government of India (as reported by Smartraveller)
layers.process: Smartraveller reports that Indian authorities have closed the Integrated Check Post at the Attari border, the land crossing with Pakistan in Punjab. It advises making other plans if you intended to travel between Pakistan and India by land, and following local authorities.

sources.supports: sub-national rule as stated in the Local laws, Safety or Local travel section (read directly)

laws.rule: The Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act 2003 as amended for Punjab by Punjab Act 18 of 2018 (new section 4-A) bars opening or running a hookah bar, or serving hookah to customers anywhere, including an eating house. A police officer of sub-inspector rank or above may seize the equipment (section 13-A).
laws.penalty_signal: Section 21-A: 1 to 3 years in jail and a fine of INR 20,000 to 50,000 (about A$298 to A$746). The offence is cognizable.
